title: Pilot Officers B W Jobling and F W Weston
memorial_details: description: ON THE AFTERNOON OF 31ST AUGUST 1943 / DH MOSQUITO NF MK2 DZ739 OF / 157 SQUADRON BASED AT RAF HUNSDON / CRASHED NEAR THIS SPOT DURING / A SHORT NIGHT FLYING TEST PRIOR TO OPERATIONS THAT EVENING / BOTH CREW MEMBERS LOST THEIR LIVES / (photo) / THIS PLAQUE IS DEDICATED TO PILOT P/O B.W. 'BARNEY' JOBLING / AND NAVIGATOR P/O F.W. 'FRED' WESTON. / REMEMBERED WITH PRIDE BY THEIR SONS AND FAMILIES. / 'LEST WE FORGET'
